Our model makes Stony Brook a 5.2-point favorite, projecting a 64-59 final, and gives Stony Brook a 67% chance to win. The betting market has Stony Brook favored by 4.5 with a total of 126. The model leans Stony Brook -4.5 and Under 126.
Players to watch: Bryce Eaton of Saint Peter's, 14.2 points a game; Jordan Mathews of Saint Peter's, 4.8 points a game; Trey Patterson of Saint Peter's, 3.9 points a game.
flavor: Jersey City's Exchange Place district, home to Saint Peter's neighbors on the waterfront and known as Wall Street West, is one of the largest financial centers in the United States.
401924882.byline: Carmen Rosario, The Jersey City Clarion
